$comment: Cardinal & Oak compliance ticket seed. Create a Linear project called 'Cardinal & Oak — Compliance' before importing. Labels referenced: 'compliance', 'P0', 'P1', 'P2', 'P3', and a label per section (e.g. 'entity', 'marketing', 'privacy'). Use Linear's API or their CLI (`linear create-issue`) to bulk-load. Estimates are in t-shirt size (XS=1hr, S=half-day, M=1day, L=2-3 days, XL=1wk+).

project.name: Cardinal & Oak — Compliance
project.description: Audit readiness and regulatory compliance tracking for Cardinal & Oak, LLC. See COMPLIANCE.md at repo root for the full controls matrix.

issues.title: Form Cardinal & Oak, LLC with CT Secretary of State
issues.description: File Certificate of Organization with CT SOS. Designate registered agent. Save Cert of Org PDF to /compliance/entity/. Blocker for all downstream work — footer on site already claims 'Cardinal & Oak, LLC'.

issues.title: Obtain EIN from IRS
issues.description: Apply for EIN after LLC is formed. Online at irs.gov/businesses. Save SS-4 confirmation.

issues.title: Draft and execute Operating Agreement
issues.description: Even single-member LLCs benefit from a written OA. Have CT attorney review. Store signed copy in /compliance/entity/.

issues.title: Open dedicated business bank account
issues.description: No commingling with personal accounts or Financial Holding. Bank needs EIN + Cert of Org. Ask about business-credit-line eligibility for deal funding.

issues.title: File CT DRS tax registration (Form REG-1)
issues.description: Register for CT tax purposes. Required even if no sales tax nexus.

issues.title: File FinCEN BOI report for the LLC
issues.description: Corporate Transparency Act — Beneficial Ownership Information report. Required within 30 days of LLC formation. Different from property-level reporting. Free filing at boiefiling.fincen.gov.

issues.title: Establish business address (PO Box / UPS Store / physical)
issues.description: Must match what appears in Privacy Policy, Terms, Fair Housing page, and site footer. Currently site lists 'Hartford, Connecticut' generically — need a real receive-mail address.

issues.title: Engage CT real-estate attorney for compliance review
issues.description: Single most important P0 item. Need an attorney familiar with CT non-financed residential acquisitions, foreclosure-rescue statutes, and CUTPA. Budget: $1,500–$3,000 for initial engagement. Deliverables: purchase agreement template, foreclosure-addendum template, walkthrough of CT-specific disclosure obligations, review of Privacy/Terms/Fair Housing pages.

issues.title: Decide: keep 'Behind on payments' situation on site?
issues.description: Highest-liability situation category. If keeping, need attorney-drafted protocol covering CT equity-purchaser statutes, cooling-off periods, mandatory disclosures, non-waivable rights. If removing, edit index.html to drop the 'Pre-foreclosure' situation card and related FAQ text.

issues.title: Create substantiation file for every claim on the site
issues.description: One folder per claim at /compliance/marketing/substantiation/. Each folder: the claim (verbatim), the source/documentation backing it, the date reviewed. Required defense under CUTPA and FTC Act §5. Review quarterly.

issues.title: Set up ad archive system
issues.description: Every version of every ad, every placement, every run date. PDFs preferred. Retain 3+ years. Folder: /compliance/marketing/ad-archive/YYYY/MM/.

issues.title: Publish Privacy Policy at /privacy
issues.description: Starter version generated (privacy.html). Review with counsel before relying on it in production. Linked from footer and intake form consent text.

issues.title: Publish Terms of Use at /terms
issues.description: Starter version generated (terms.html). Review with counsel. Linked from footer.

issues.title: Publish Fair Housing page at /fair-housing
issues.description: Non-discrimination policy + complaint channels. Starter version generated (fair-housing.html). Review with counsel.

issues.title: Add tcpa_consent_at column to seller_leads Supabase table
issues.description: ALTER TABLE seller_leads ADD COLUMN tcpa_consent_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(). Form must capture consent timestamp on every submit for TCPA defense. Also add ip_address, user_agent columns for evidentiary completeness.

issues.title: Enable Supabase RLS on seller_leads (anon insert-only, service_role full)
issues.description: See policy SQL in session notes. Verify anon key cannot SELECT after deploy. Test with a no-auth query from a separate session.

issues.title: Enable MFA across all infra: Supabase, Vercel, GitHub, Google Workspace
issues.description: Non-negotiable for any service holding PII. Use authenticator app (not SMS where avoidable).

issues.title: Write data retention policy
issues.description: Document at /compliance/privacy/retention-policy.md. Leads: 3yr. Transactions: 7yr. Email: 7yr. TCPA consent: 4yr. Link from Privacy Policy.

issues.title: Write breach-response playbook
issues.description: First 72hr actions, escalation contacts, notification obligations under CT statute. /compliance/privacy/breach-response.md.

issues.title: Sign DPAs with all PII vendors
issues.description: Supabase, Vercel, SendGrid/Resend, Twilio, Google Workspace. Each has a standard DPA form — fill out, sign, file at /compliance/privacy/dpas/.

issues.title: Build OFAC SDN screening procedure for every seller
issues.description: Free API at sanctionssearch.ofac.treas.gov. Build into lead workflow: before any offer is sent, screen seller name + any co-owners. Log result (timestamp, name checked, result, reviewer) at /compliance/aml/ofac-log/YYYY/. Retain 5+ years.

issues.title: Write AML policy document
issues.description: 2-3 pages: screening procedure, red flags, SAR-filing decision tree, recordkeeping standard. /compliance/aml/aml-policy.md.

issues.title: Draft proof-of-funds letter template
issues.description: Must be producible within 24hr of seller request (stated on site). Either bank letter, capital partner letter, or both. Keep current version at /compliance/financial/pof-template.pdf.

issues.title: Document wire instruction verification procedure
issues.description: Callback to known number on every wire instruction. Written procedure shared with closing attorney. Include standard warning-to-seller email about wire fraud.

issues.title: Monitor FinCEN RRE Rule appeal status quarterly
issues.description: Rule was vacated by federal district court on March 19, 2026. Appeal possible. If reinstated, reporting obligations kick in for non-financed LLC residential purchases. Calendar as recurring quarterly review.

issues.title: Bind Commercial General Liability insurance ($1M/$2M)
issues.description: Required before first property acquisition. Get quotes from 3 carriers. Compare specifically for coverage of real-estate investment activity, not just general commercial.

issues.title: Bind Errors & Omissions insurance ($500K-$1M)
issues.description: Covers professional liability claims — misleading statements, failure-to-disclose, etc. Pair with GL.

issues.title: Bind Cyber Liability insurance ($500K-$1M)
issues.description: Required because intake form collects PII. Covers breach response, notification costs, regulatory defense.

issues.title: Confirm lead-paint liability coverage for pre-1978 properties
issues.description: Often excluded from standard commercial GL. Request rider or separate policy. Critical — CT has material lead-paint liability exposure for owners.

issues.title: Confirm auto policy covers business use of personal vehicle
issues.description: Visiting properties in a personal car for business purposes may void personal auto coverage in a claim. Call carrier and confirm or add rider.

issues.title: Build municipal lien search procedure
issues.description: Every CT acquisition. Coordinate with title company or closing attorney. Document as checklist item on every transaction file.

issues.title: Establish relationship with CT title company / closing attorney
issues.description: CT is attorney-state — all closings must go through licensed attorney. Get pricing schedule, standard timeline, and draft closing packet format.

issues.title: Build lead-paint disclosure workflow for pre-1978 homes
issues.description: Federal + CT requirement. EPA pamphlet delivery + disclosure form on every pre-1978 transaction, both buying and selling. Template form + procedure doc.

issues.title: Build CT Residential Property Condition Disclosure Report workflow (for resales)
issues.description: CGS § 20-327b. Required when we resell any property we've acquired. Template + procedure.

issues.title: Build tenant-notification procedure for occupied rental acquisitions
issues.description: If we acquire a rental with tenants in place, there are CT-specific notice requirements. Procedure doc + template notice.

issues.title: Set up complaint intake and response procedure
issues.description: Dedicated email (office@) monitored daily. 5-business-day response SLA. Log every complaint + response + resolution at /compliance/complaints/log.md. Retain 5+ years.

issues.title: Maintain regulator contact list
issues.description: Pre-loaded contacts for CT DCP, CT AG, HUD, CT CHRO, FinCEN, title insurer, cyber carrier, GL carrier, attorney. At /compliance/contacts.md. Update annually.

issues.title: Quarterly review: site claims still accurate?
issues.description: Recurring calendar event. Walk every page. Flag anything that's become stale or that we can't still substantiate. Update substantiation file dates.

issues.title: Quarterly review: ad archive reconciled
issues.description: Every placement in the quarter accounted for with a PDF + publication + date. Spot-check 3 random ones.

issues.title: Annual: CT SOS annual report filed
issues.description: Calendar annual. Ensure LLC remains in good standing.

issues.title: Annual: Policy pages reviewed by counsel
issues.description: Privacy, Terms, Fair Housing. Verify no statutory changes have made language stale.

issues.title: Annual: Insurance policies reviewed and renewed
issues.description: Check coverage amounts still adequate for portfolio size. Shop rates if premium >15% YoY.

issues.title: Annual: Vendor DPA renewals reviewed
issues.description: Verify vendor list current, all DPAs still in force and current version signed.

issues.title: Quarterly: Complaint log review — patterns?
issues.description: Read every complaint in the quarter. Look for systemic issues. Address root cause if any.
